title: 38_143685_box_Incident_Summaries_173-233
doc_notes: This document contains a series of incident summary sheets for unidentified aerial phenomena, most of which are distant sightings, with one claimed physical trace encounter. / This document contains incident summaries from the PURSUE-R1 collection, detailing various aerial sightings, some of which involve close-range encounters with unidentified objects.

encounters.summary: Observer reported a mysterious light in Golden Gate Park that illuminated the ocean and caused a physical sensation like an electric arc, resulting in a new bruise on his hand.
encounters.location_name: Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, Calif
encounters.quote: He felt something like an electric arc which seemed to have the power to lower his hand like a sack of shot

encounters.summary: Lt. Jackson and Lt. Combs reported an oval object with no wings or tail circling Andrews AF Base for 15-18 minutes, performing evasive maneuvers and vertical climbs.
encounters.entity_appearance: oval, dull gray/whitish-grey, no wings or tail
encounters.entity_behavior: evasive, tight circles, vertical climbs, high acceleration
encounters.location_name: Andrews AF Base, Camp Springs, Md

encounters.summary: Sgt. Wright observed a snow-white, wingless object with a straight body tapering to a point, appearing to have windows, flying intermittently through clouds.
encounters.entity_appearance: snow-white, straight body tapering to a point, no tail, windows
encounters.quote: It appeared to be sky writing

encounters.summary: Mr. and Mrs. Tom Rush observed a dark blue/black cigar-shaped object without wings that crossed their flight path and accelerated.
encounters.entity_appearance: cigar-shaped, dark blue or black, 60ft long, 10ft wide
encounters.quote: as the object made its turn, it was then that I noticed the object didn't have wings.
